user.title: Add an independent price site
user.description: Create one independent pricing site. A single suitable official Nord Pool entry is suggested for confirmation; ambiguous sources require a choice. No contract or rates are copied from another site. Official Nord Pool uses ex-VAT DKK/MWh. An entity source must expose slots, currency, unit_of_measurement, vat_included and provider verified_at; unknown conventions fail closed. After adding the site, open Options to configure dated rates.

data.id: Stable site ID (lowercase letters, digits and underscores)
data.name: Site name
data.vat: Spot and automatic DSO VAT fraction (0.25 = 25%)
data.source_type: Spot source type (official Nord Pool or explicit entity contract)
data.price_unit: Confirmed input money unit (official Nord Pool: DKK/MWh)
data.price_basis: Confirmed input VAT/price basis (official Nord Pool: spot excluding VAT)
data.stale_minutes: Maximum provider verification age (minutes; entity source only)

wizard_site.title: 1 / 6 · Site and source

wizard_source.title: 1 / 6 · Installed source
wizard_source.description:
{progress} · {draft_status} (✓ saved / ✎ draft)

Select your already installed official Nord Pool integration by name. Its input is automatically DKK/MWh excluding VAT. Entity-provider fields appear only for advanced sources.

**Continue preserves the page; active settings change only on Save & verify. Close/reload does not submit typed fields. Choose Continue first.**

data_description.nordpool_entry: Select the integration by its readable name. No opaque ID is typed. If absent, add official Nord Pool in Devices & services first.
data_description.navigation: Choose Next, Back or Review, then Continue. Continue preserves this page in a resumable draft; active pricing changes only on Save & verify.

data_description.price_unit: Confirm the provider contract. This is not the preferred display unit.
data_description.price_basis: Final all-in input cannot be combined with extra tariffs/VAT.

data_description.stale_minutes: Stale, missing or future verification fails closed.

wizard_location.title: 1 / 6 · Area and VAT
wizard_location.description:
{progress} · {draft_status} (✓ saved / ✎ draft)

Confirm the source’s delivery area and timezone. Enter 25 for 25% VAT. This VAT applies to spot/automatic grid rates; each manual rate declares its own VAT.

**Continue preserves the page; active settings change only on Save & verify. Close/reload does not submit typed fields. Choose Continue first.**

data_description.area: Suggested from the selected integration. DK1 = west Denmark; DK2 = east Denmark. Confirm the correct area for this site.
data_description.timezone: Danish areas suggest Europe/Copenhagen. The timezone defines local tariff dates and 92/96/100-quarter DST days.
data_description.vat_percent: 25 means 25%. Nord Pool input is DKK/MWh before VAT; the engine converts units and applies VAT once. This is not a final all-in price by itself.
data_description.navigation: Choose Next, Back or Review, then Continue. Continue preserves this page in a resumable draft; active pricing changes only on Save & verify.

wizard_supplier.title: 3 / 6 · Supplier contract
wizard_supplier.description:
{progress} · {draft_status} (✓ saved / ✎ draft)

What is your supplier markup above the spot price? Enter the amount from your electricity bill or contract, preferably in øre/kWh. Confirm VAT and effective dates. EWII and other suppliers require your own terms.

You may explicitly approve a provisional estimate or finish with missing information. Missing prices never become 0.

Continue preserves this page as a draft; Save & verify applies it. Closing does not submit typed fields. Choose Continue first.

data.approve_estimate: I approve an UNVERIFIED estimate for visualization only

data_description.amount: Find the per-kWh markup under trading fee, spot-price supplement or variable electricity price on your bill/contract. Exclude fixed monthly subscriptions. Enter 0 only if your contract explicitly says 0.
data_description.unit: Default is øre/kWh: 3 øre = 0.030 DKK. This is your contract unit, separate from Nord Pool input.
data_description.vat_included: Check whether the quoted amount includes VAT to avoid adding it twice.
data_description.valid_to: Exclusive end: a contract through September 30 ends October 1. Do not extend beyond known terms.
data_description.replace_periods: Replaces overlapping portions only. Other dates and tariffs are preserved. Inspect saved periods under Advanced.
data_description.approve_estimate: Provisional prices are ESTIMATED/UNVERIFIED. They never enter verified history or make the consumer API READY. Do not use them for charging control.
data_description.supplier: Selection creates no markup. Historical EWII .030 DKK excluding VAT applies only June–September 2026.

wizard_charges.title: 4 / 6 · National charges and tax
wizard_charges.description:
{progress} · {draft_status} (✓ saved / ✎ draft)

Final prices need Energinet network/system tariffs and electricity tax. Enable the documented bounded baseline, or enter verified dated manual rules from Review → Advanced. Baseline: 2026 Energinet 0.043/0.072 DKK/kWh ex VAT; tax 0.008 for 2026–2027. This is documented data, not live legislation discovery. Heating requires explicit verified eligibility and a rate; registration alone never creates a discount.

**Continue preserves the page; active settings change only on Save & verify. Close/reload does not submit typed fields. Choose Continue first.**

data_description.navigation: Choose Next, Back or Review, then Continue. Continue preserves this page in a resumable draft; active pricing changes only on Save & verify.
data_description.danish_public_rates: Opt in only when applicable: Energinet net .043/system .072 ex VAT during 2026; tax .008 during 2026–2027. Manual locked periods override. No later rule is guessed.
data_description.heating_registered: Never inferred from a heat pump. A reduced rate also requires an explicitly verified eligible tax rule and same-year consumption evidence.
data_description.annual_usage_kwh: Only used with an explicit eligible heating rule, registration and usage year. No automatic discount is created.
data_description.usage_year: Evidence must match the delivery year for any explicit heating rule.

site_management.description:

hacs_channel.title: HACS beta updates
hacs_channel.description:
Only prereleases are published. With Show beta versions off, HACS falls back to main’s commit as its available version. This action enables the beta channel ONLY for Energy Price Engine through HACS’s own API and refreshes information. It installs nothing and changes no other repository.

If unavailable: open PE in HACS → Show beta versions → refresh information.

error.name_required: Enter a name for this pricing site.
error.invalid_id: Use lowercase a-z, digits and underscores, starting with a letter/digit.
error.duplicate_id: This ID already belongs to a site. Use another ID or configure that existing site.
error.source_required: Select the installed official Nord Pool integration.
error.legacy_source: A legacy HACS Nordpool shadows the official integration. Use the official source in an approved test setup; do not silently substitute it.

error.verification_required: Check your contract and confirm verification.
error.deletion_confirmation: Type the exact site ID and confirm permanent deletion.
error.deletion_failed: Cleanup failed. The site stays stopped. Correct file access and retry; check diagnostics before reinstalling.
error.hacs_channel_failed: HACS could not confirm the beta channel. Sign in as an administrator. Open PE in HACS, enable Show beta versions and refresh information.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm your agreement or approved estimate.
error.invalid_source: Choose an official Nord Pool source with a supported Danish area.
error.invalid_decimal: Enter a non-negative decimal amount, for example 0.25 or 3.125.
error.entity_required: Select a timestamped price entity for this alternate source.
error.invalid_energy: Supply non-negative kWh for every consecutive quarter, for example 0.5. Blank or missing quarters are not zero.
error.invalid_quarter: Choose a quarter from the list.
error.future_measurement: Future energy is planned, not measured. Choose planned energy or an earlier quarter.
error.official_required: Remove the alternate integration shadowing the Nord Pool domain and choose the official Home Assistant integration.
error.source_area_required: Configure DK1 or DK2 in the selected Nord Pool integration first.
error.invalid_horizon: Choose future quarter boundaries with the end after the start.

Baseline: 2026 Energinet 0.043/0.072 DKK/kWh ex VAT; tax 0.008 for 2026–2027. This is documented data, not live legislation discovery. Heating requires explicit verified eligibility and a rate; registration alone never creates a discount.
